facts.text: I am a solicitor and construction lawyer with more than 10 years of experience specialising in construction law.
I regularly advise homeowners and builders and developers regarding their contractual and legal rights.
I represent homeowners and builders and developers in NSW, VIC, and QLD, Australia.
I represent homeowners and builders and developers in all courts of competent jurisdiction.
I have advised homeowners, builders, and contractors and developers regarding repudiating a building contract.
I have advised homeowners, builders, and contractors and developers on their contract rights, risks and obligations.
I have negotiated and amended contracts to reflect their intentions.
